name: Jobylon
niche: enterprise applicant tracking for multi-brand employers (Sweden)
notes: Site says: "Jobylon integrates seamlessly with most major third-party apps and partners" Developer portal lists Feed API, Partner API and Push API. review.note: Homepage, integrations and developer portal read; partner program, job board posting and developer docs confirmed, API access route not stated.
